title: Measuring the Effect of Influential Messages on Varying Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model-generated text responses conditioned on contrasting political personas (e.g., Pro-President Trump vs. Anti-President Trump) to political news headlines to verify if the generated stance aligns with the designated political persona.
Evaluating model-generated responses conditioned on opposing geopolitical personas (e.g., Pro-Russia vs. Pro-Ukraine) responding to international conflict news headlines to verify stance consistency.
Testing response generation consistency using personas with contrasting moral or psychological foundations (e.g., Purity & Love vs. Degradation) in reaction to general news events.
